verdict.rationale: Bento offers migration help when switching platforms, a CLI with 50+ account-management commands, and an API for subscribers/events data, which together suggest some data portability, but there is no explicit documentation of a full 'export all data' feature in open formats like CSV/JSON. Missing for 10: explicit data export/download feature documentation, confirmation of open standard formats (CSV/JSON), and evidence of exporting all data types (events, broadcasts, automations) not just subscribers.
